data.one_liner: A collection of Dart and Flutter lint rules to enforce consistent, safe code.
data.what_it_does: Provides multiple ready‑to‑use analysis_options.yaml includes for Dart and Flutter projects, with optional analyzer plugin diagnostics. The rules cover safety, readability, performance and brevity.
use_when: You want a curated set of lint rules without configuring each individually
You need an analyzer plugin for extra diagnostics
You prefer a single dev_dependency to manage linting
avoid_when: You need runtime functionality like state‑management or networking
You prefer a custom lint set not covered by this package
strengths: Comprehensive rule list with clear rationales
Keeps up‑to‑date with latest Dart versions
weaknesses: Limited to the rules defined by the author

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Dart lint set with minimal configuration

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Flutter‑specific lint rules maintained by the Flutter team

data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  rexios_lints: latest

# analysis_options.yaml
include: package:rexios_lints/flutter/core.yaml
